name: library-management-system
description: Local Hebrew RTL library management system

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix e2e
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --prefix backend --if-present && npm run test --prefix frontend --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test --prefix e2e
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix shared && npm run clean --prefix backend && npm run clean --prefix frontend
